## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete need and the behavior this change should produce.

## Scope and ownership

Name the component, owning design document, dependencies, and exclusions.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] State observable completion criteria.
- [ ] Include failure, stale-data, or identity scenarios where relevant.

## Validation and evidence

List meaningful checks and required hardware/profile measurements. Identify proposed targets separately from results.

## Delivery

Link the decision record, related issues, PR, and self-contained HTML report when available. Exclude credentials and participant data.
